prompt:
A sheet of 16 pixel-art icons for a dark fantasy tactical RPG, in the style of detailed 16-bit SNES/GBA-era RPG icons. Square 1:1 image, an exact 4 by 4 grid of 16 equal square tiles separated by thin straight gutters of pure black (#000000), no outer border beyond the gutters. Each tile is one icon on its own rounded-square tile filled with the colour named for it, with a subtle darker vignette. Every icon is drawn large and centred, with clear dark outlines, hand-placed pixel clusters, a limited palette with 4 shades per colour, a warm light from the upper left and a thin warm rim light. The icons show ranger and brawler skills, each showing the action itself so it reads at a glance at small size. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no frame, no watermark. Row by row, left to right:
Row 1: a rain of several arrows arcing down onto an area (tile deep dark red); a drawn bow with a single arrow and a sighting line (tile deep dark red); an arrow pinning a foot to the ground (tile deep dark red); a barbed arrowhead dripping blood (tile deep dark red).
Row 2: an arrow striking the centre of a target (tile deep dark red); an arrow striking a knee with a slowing chain (tile deep dark red); a figure leaping backwards away with motion lines (tile deep dark teal); a low cut to the back of a leg, the leg buckling (tile deep dark red).
Row 3: a wide hooking punch landing with a big impact star (tile deep dark red); a fist driving into a stomach, a shock ring (tile deep dark red); a figure dashing forward low with a trail, fist leading (tile deep dark red); a low spinning leg sweep with a dust arc (tile deep dark red).
Row 4: a shoulder charge bursting forward with speed lines (tile deep dark red); a spinning kick inside a whirlwind ring (tile deep dark red); a fist smashing down cracking the ground (tile deep dark red); a reeling head with stars and a question mark (tile deep dark purple).
note: --no-ref inferred, not recorded: the option was added in this same commit for the icon sheets, and the prompt asks for no portrait style
